summary: A parametric deck card. One world number, printed on the face, and the Pangea engine paints the same landscape plate again.
license_note: Both faces are exports from the named engine at the printed address; the engine is the source and the PNG is an artifact of it.
origin: Child of two projects, both carried whole into one file: BIFURCATA (https://persona500.com/bifurcata, card BIFURCATA-011) grows the trees; LEVIATHAN (https://persona500.com/leviathan, card LEVIATHAN-010, formerly FIELD ORGANISM) grinds the pigment. Named CONVERGENCE until 2026-08-23.
